extracted.name: Buttered-Braised Cabbage
extracted.description: This buttered cabbage recipe is super quick and easy to make by simply braising shredded green cabbage in butter until tender and delicious.
instruction_lines: Heat 3 tablespoons butter in a large pot over medium-low heat until mostly melted. Add cabbage; top with remaining 1 tablespoon butter. Cover and cook until cabbage is tender, about 10 minutes. Uncover and stir cabbage to coat evenly with melted butter.
Remove from heat and let stand, covered, about 3 minutes. Season with black pepper.
